topic: Formulas for frequency based on days and frames
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on developing mathematical formulas to predict frequency. Initially, a linear dependency of frequency on the number of days was established. The initial formulas provided were for 7 days and included 'x' (number of frames). After discussion regarding the complexity of creating a single model that accurately predicts both RJ/SP metrics, it was agreed that separate models would be implemented.

The final formulas developed incorporate both the number of frames ('x') and the number of days ('d').
decisions: Separate mathematical models will be used for different metrics (RJ and SP) rather than a single combined model.
action_items: The formula incorporating 'x' (frames) and 'd' (days) has been delivered.
